resources.name: MXToolbox SuperTool
resources.when_to_use: Email bounces (550), SPF/DKIM/DMARC verification, MX routing, and IP blacklist checks.
resources.instructions: Enter client domain and prefix commands like mx:contoso.com, spf:contoso.com, dmarc:contoso.com, or blacklist:198.51.100.10. Count SPF DNS lookups (must stay <= 10). Never test private RFC1918 IPs.

resources.name: Google Admin Toolbox (Dig & Messageheader)
resources.when_to_use: Inspect raw email headers (Messageheader) for delivery hops/delay or check DNS/HAR traces.
resources.instructions: Use Messageheader to paste sanitized email headers and highlight delay hops + Authentication-Results (SPF/DKIM/DMARC). Use Dig to query TXT/MX/CNAME records against 8.8.8.8.

resources.name: Microsoft Remote Connectivity Analyzer
resources.when_to_use: Exchange Online Autodiscover failures, Outlook desktop connectivity, or inbound/outbound SMTP TLS checks.
resources.instructions: Open Office 365 -> Outlook Connectivity or Inbound/Outbound SMTP Email tests. Verify Autodiscover CNAME points to autodiscover.outlook.com and SMTP supports TLS 1.2.

resources.name: DNS Checker (Global Propagation)
resources.when_to_use: Verify whether recent DNS/MX/SPF/SSL validation TXT edits have propagated globally.
resources.instructions: Enter the FQDN, pick record type (A, MX, TXT, CNAME), and compare global resolvers before concluding a DNS cutover failed.

resources.name: Qualys SSL Labs Server Test
resources.when_to_use: Public HTTPS certificate errors, missing intermediate CA chain, or deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 audits.
resources.instructions: Enter the public hostname and check 'Do not show the results on the boards'. Inspect 'Chain issues' for Incomplete Intermediate Chains and verify TLS 1.2/1.3 grades.

resources.name: VirusTotal
resources.when_to_use: Verify suspect executables by SHA-256 hash, inspect malicious IPs/domains, or check Defender false positives.
resources.instructions: PRIVACY RULE: Compute SHA-256 locally via PowerShell (Get-FileHash) and search ONLY the hash/URL/IP — NEVER upload confidential client documents or proprietary installers.

resources.name: AbuseIPDB
resources.when_to_use: Check whether an external sign-in IP in Entra/Workspace/SSH logs is a known VPN, Tor exit, or brute-force scanner.
resources.instructions: Paste the suspicious source IP from Sign-in Logs or /var/log/auth.log to check ASN, ISP, usage type (Data Center/VPN vs Residential), and recent abuse reports.

resources.name: URLScan.io
resources.when_to_use: Safely detonate suspicious phishing links from user tickets without opening them on a corporate endpoint.
resources.instructions: Select 'Unlisted' or 'Private' scan before submitting suspicious URLs (strip user tracking/token query parameters first!) to inspect screenshots, redirects, and hosting ASN.

resources.name: Have I Been Pwned
resources.when_to_use: Check if a user's corporate email appeared in third-party credential breaches during BEC/lockout investigations.
resources.instructions: Search the user address or check Domain Search for tenant-wide breach exposure and verify the user does not reuse passwords across external sites.

resources.name: Microsoft Security Intelligence File Submission
resources.when_to_use: Submit a verified clean, digitally signed LOB binary falsely quarantined by Microsoft Defender Antivirus.
resources.instructions: Sign in as Enterprise/Software Developer, select Microsoft Defender Antivirus, upload the clean signed sample, and record the Submission ID for client tracking.

resources.name: IPv4 CIDR Subnet Calculator (ipcalc)
resources.when_to_use: Calculate usable host ranges, broadcast addresses, network IDs, and wildcard masks for DHCP, VPN, or VLAN changes.
resources.instructions: Enter IP and CIDR prefix (e.g., 10.0.10.0/24 or /23) to verify usable HostMin-HostMax before expanding DHCP scopes or writing firewall ACLs.

resources.name: Visual Subnet Calculator
resources.when_to_use: Split or join CIDR blocks visually when carving new VLANs, server racks, or VPN pools.
resources.instructions: Enter base network + mask (e.g., 10.0.0.0/20), click Divide to carve smaller subnets, and verify zero overlap with existing office/VPN ranges.

resources.name: Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit
resources.when_to_use: Look up ASN ownership, PTR reverse DNS, and upstream ISP peering during WAN or Data Center fiber routing incidents.
resources.instructions: Search an IP, ASN, or ISP name to verify reverse DNS (PTR) matches mail servers and inspect announced CIDR prefixes.

resources.name: Downdetector
resources.when_to_use: Fast 10-second check for regional ISP, cellular carrier, or SaaS vendor outages before deep endpoint debugging.
resources.instructions: Check spike reports for the user's regional ISP or SaaS vendor alongside official vendor status dashboards.

resources.name: Microsoft Entra Admin Center
resources.when_to_use: Sign-in logs (AADSTS codes), MFA/TAP resets, Conditional Access policy evaluation, and BitLocker keys.
resources.instructions: Check Monitoring & health -> Sign-in logs first for AADSTS failure codes and Conditional Access tabs; check Users -> Authentication methods for TAP.

resources.name: Microsoft Intune Admin Center
resources.when_to_use: Device compliance checks, Windows 11 Feature Update readiness, Autopilot hashes, FileVault/BitLocker recovery keys, and remote Sync.
resources.instructions: Navigate to Devices -> All devices -> <device> for Compliance, Recovery keys, and Sync. Check Reports -> Windows updates for Win11 safeguard holds.

resources.name: Microsoft 365 Admin Center
resources.when_to_use: Assign M365/Windows/Intune licenses, reset passwords, manage Shared Mailboxes, and check tenant Service Health.
resources.instructions: Check Billing -> Licenses and Active users -> Licenses and apps before troubleshooting missing desktop Office/Exchange/Intune features.

resources.name: M365 Maps (Microsoft Licensing Matrix)
resources.when_to_use: Verify instantly which Microsoft 365 bundle includes Intune, Entra ID P1/P2, Defender, or Windows 11 Enterprise Subscription Activation.
resources.instructions: Open Business Premium, E3, or E5 interactive diagrams to confirm whether the user's SKU actually entitles Windows Pro/Enterprise upgrade or Intune MDM.

resources.name: Microsoft KMS Client Setup Keys (GVLK)
resources.when_to_use: Retrieve official public Microsoft Generic Volume License Keys (GVLK) when pointing domain Windows/Server hosts back to KMS or ADBA.
resources.instructions: Copy ONLY the matching OS edition GVLK from Microsoft Learn, install with slmgr /ipk <GVLK>, then activate via slmgr /ato against internal KMS/ADBA (never use third-party activators).

resources.name: Windows 11 Supported Processors & Hardware Specs
resources.when_to_use: Confirm whether an older Windows 10 endpoint CPU officially supports Windows 11 during Intune Feature Update migrations.
resources.instructions: Match the exact Intel/AMD processor model from Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor against the Windows 11 supported CPU list before targeting feature updates.

resources.name: Microsoft 365 Service Health Status
resources.when_to_use: Verify global Microsoft 365 / Entra / Teams outages when tenant Admin Center itself is unreachable.
resources.instructions: Check active advisories here alongside tenant Admin Center -> Health -> Service health before mass-resetting client Outlook/OneDrive caches.

resources.name: Google Workspace Admin Console
resources.when_to_use: Unlock suspended Google Workspace accounts, issue 2SV backup codes, inspect Email Log Search, and manage Shared Drive permissions.
resources.instructions: Always open in an Incognito/dedicated corporate browser profile signed ONLY into admin@contoso.com to prevent multi-account 403 collisions.

resources.name: Google Cloud Console
resources.when_to_use: Inspect GCP Project IAM bindings, Organization Policies, suspended Billing accounts, and API quota limits.
resources.instructions: Verify the top Project selector, IAM & Admin -> IAM roles, and Billing -> Account Management. Ensure Google Cloud Platform is enabled in admin.google.com for the user's OU.

resources.name: Google Workspace Status Dashboard
resources.when_to_use: Confirm whether Gmail, Google Drive, or Admin Console is experiencing a service-wide incident.
resources.instructions: Check red/amber service rows and click the incident title for regional scope and official ETA updates.

resources.name: Adobe Admin Console
resources.when_to_use: Assign/revoke Adobe Acrobat Pro or Creative Cloud licenses and verify Federated/Enterprise ID directory sync.
resources.instructions: Go to Users -> search user email -> confirm active Product Assignment (Acrobat Pro / CC) and tell the user to pick 'Company or School Account' at sign-in.

resources.name: Adobe Acrobat Cleaner Tool & Enterprise Docs
resources.when_to_use: Cleanly remove corrupted Adobe Acrobat/Reader installations, broken licensing stores, or stuck PDF previewers.
resources.instructions: Download ONLY from official Adobe Enterprise Toolkit docs, close all Office/Acrobat apps, run Cleaner Tool for the affected product track, reboot, and reinstall cleanly.

resources.name: Synaptics DisplayLink Drivers
resources.when_to_use: Blank external monitors on USB-C/USB-A DisplayLink docks (especially Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3 Macs with 2+ external displays).
resources.instructions: Match exact OS (Windows or macOS DisplayLink Manager), install official driver, and on macOS grant Screen Recording permission under Privacy & Security.

resources.name: Apple Official Startup Key Combinations & Recovery
resources.when_to_use: Verify exact Mac Recovery Mode, Safe Mode, Diagnostics, and Startup Manager key combos by Apple Silicon vs. Intel.
resources.instructions: Identify Apple Silicon (hold Power button) vs Intel (hold Command+R) first using uname -m or model year before guiding the user through boot steps.

resources.name: Microsoft Azure Portal
resources.when_to_use: Inspect Azure VMs, Boot Diagnostics, Serial Console, Network Security Groups (NSG), RBAC roles, Key Vault, and Storage firewalls.
resources.instructions: Filter by Subscription and Resource Group first. Use Resource Health, Boot Diagnostics, and Effective Security Rules on the VM NIC before changing NSG or RBAC assignments.

resources.name: Azure Service Status
resources.when_to_use: Confirm whether regional Azure outages or capacity incidents explain AllocationFailed or unreachable VM/storage errors.
resources.instructions: Check the target Azure region (e.g., Canada Central, Canada East, East US) and combine with tenant-specific Azure Service Health alerts in Portal.

resources.name: Microsoft Entra AADSTS Error Code Lookup
resources.when_to_use: Decode any AADSTS code returned during developer app consent, OAuth sign-in, or Conditional Access geo-blocking.
resources.instructions: Paste the numeric code or full AADSTS string (e.g., AADSTS65001, AADSTS53003, AADSTS7000215) to view official Microsoft remediation details.
